description: React component for the Memory Match game application, including game logic, UI rendering, state management, and accessibility features.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the Memory Match game, managing game state, user interactions, and UI layout.

methods.name: announce
methods.description: Helper function to update aria-live region for screen reader announcements.

methods.name: handleFlip
methods.description: Handles user flipping a card, manages match checking, and updates game state accordingly.

methods.name: handleRestart
methods.description: Resets the game, optionally with a new seed for deterministic shuffling.

methods.name: handleChangeDifficulty
methods.description: Changes game difficulty and resets relevant state.

methods.name: onPlayAgain
methods.description: Handles replaying the game after a win.
